purpose: Explicit context envelope for TransArmor Load Data Segment artifacts.

conditionalContext.fieldLayout: Segment 116's own field layout beyond Segment Type/Segment Length is REVIEW_REQUIRED: SEG116-SME-001 (external TransArmor document required).
conditionalContext.envelopeShape: Exclusion of Segment 100 and Data Section 3 is a structural analogy, not confirmed: SEG116-SME-002.
conditionalContext.responseContainer: Whether Key ID/Key Data Length/Key Data sit inside a Segment 116 response container is REVIEW_REQUIRED: SEG116-SME-003.
conditionalContext.companionTable: Relationship to the Segment 111 Additional TransArmor Data sub-table (052) is REVIEW_REQUIRED: SEG116-SME-004.

validationRules: Do not use a generic Financial Transaction Request or Segment 100 context as Segment 116 proof.
Do not invent fields occupying the remaining ~44 bytes of the 50-byte segment.
Do not conflate Segment 116 with Segment 119 (Totals with Proprietary Data Load Data Segment); Section 11.4.1.2's '(Data Segment No. 116)' label is a resolved source conflict.
Missing required context is REVIEW_REQUIRED unless source proves it unnecessary.
AI fixtures are not independent source evidence.
